options: Actively ask for the new joiner's opinion in discussions and make space for them to contribute.
Choose to assign critical tasks exclusively to the experienced employees to maintain current workflow.
Ignore the current situation, as it is considered a natural and expected part of team dynamics.
Politely advise the new joiner to continue observing the team dynamics quietly and learning for now.

question: You and two friends are on a train with tickets under RAC (Reservation Against Cancellation). The ticket inspector offers to upgrade you to three full berths in exchange for a bribe. What would be the most ethical and professional way to respond to this situation?
question_hi: आप और आपके दो मित्र RAC (Reservation Against Cancellation) टिकटों के साथ एक ट्रेन में यात्रा कर रहे हैं। टिकट निरीक्षक रिश्वत के बदले आपको तीन पूर्ण बर्थ देने का प्रस्ताव रखता है। इस स्थिति में प्रतिक्रिया देने का सबसे नैतिक और पेशेवर तरीका क्या होगा?
options: Agree to pay the requested bribe to the ticket checker, justifying the action because you believe that having a full berth is necessary for a long journey.
Firmly refuse to pay the bribe and continue to travel by sitting comfortably in your originally allotted seats as per the terms of your current ticket status.
Forcibly occupy the berths by threatening the current legal occupants, regardless of the potential for physical conflict or the resulting disturbance to other passengers.
Utilize your personal connections by calling a friend who is an officer in the railways to pressure the ticket checker into providing you with berths without payment.
options_hi: यह मानते हुए कि लंबी यात्रा के लिए पूर्ण बर्थ आवश्यक है, इस कार्य को उचित ठहराते हुए टिकट चेकर को माँगी गई रिश्वत देने के लिए सहमत हो जाना।
रिश्वत देने से दृढ़ता से इनकार करना और अपनी वर्तमान टिकट स्थिति की शर्तों के अनुसार मूल रूप से आवंटित सीटों पर आराम से बैठकर यात्रा जारी रखना।
शारीरिक संघर्ष की संभावना या अन्य यात्रियों को होने वाली असुविधा की परवाह किए बिना, वर्तमान वैध यात्रियों को धमकाकर बर्थों पर बलपूर्वक कब्ज़ा करना।
बिना भुगतान के बर्थ दिलवाने हेतु टिकट चेकर पर दबाव डालने के लिए रेलवे में अधिकारी अपने किसी मित्र को फ़ोन करके अपने व्यक्तिगत संपर्कों का उपयोग करना।
explanation: Correct answer: Option B — Firmly refuse to pay the bribe and continue to travel by sitting comfortably in your originally allotted seats as per the terms of your current ticket status.
explanation_hi: Correct answer: Option B — Firmly refuse to pay the bribe and continue to travel by sitting comfortably in your originally allotted seats as per the terms of your current ticket status.

III. सभी उपग्रहों को प्रमाणन प्राप्त होता है।

question:

Which of the following responses by you demonstrates the highest level of emotional intelligence (EQ)?
question_hi:
एक प्रोजेक्ट समीक्षा बैठक के दौरान, आप देखते हैं कि एक टीम सदस्य स्पष्ट रूप से व्यथित है, अपने हाथ भींच रहा है और तनावपूर्ण, खिंची हुई आवाज़ में बोल रहा है। जब उनसे पूछा जाता है कि क्या वे कुछ कहना चाहते हैं, तो वे नीचे देखते हुए कहते हैं, "मैं ठीक हूँ, चिंता मत कीजिए।"

options: Press them immediately during the meeting to share what is wrong so the team can resolve the issue collectively on the spot.
Accept their verbal response for the duration of the meeting to preserve their privacy, but follow up with them in a private, one-on-one setting later to offer support.
Take their statement literally, assume they are completely unaffected, and dismiss the physical signs of distress from your mind moving forward.
Immediately approach the department manager after the meeting to report that the teammate appears emotionally unstable and unable to handle the current workload.
